title: AutoSell MC Plugin
description: Minecraft plugin to automatically sell collected items or the entire inventory with a single command.
body:
AUTOSELL ︱ The Essential Automated Economy Solution for Minecraft



Optimize your server's economy and enhance the player experience. Autosell is a high-performance Minecraft plugin developed by Revers Studio, specifically designed to streamline the way players interact with your server's market. By automating the selling process, you eliminate tedious manual tasks, allowing your players to focus on what really matters: gameplay.



❱ CORE FEATURES IN DEPTH:



💰 Automated Sales System:

Revolutionize how players generate income. This plugin allows for the automatic selling of items, ensuring a fluid economy where players don't have to break their rhythm to visit a shop or execute repetitive commands.



💎 Full Economy Integration:

Built to work seamlessly with your server's existing financial ecosystem. It integrates with major economy providers to ensure that every transaction is accurate, logged, and instantaneous.



🚀 High-Performance Optimization:



Engineered with efficiency in mind. Autosell is designed to handle large amounts of data and frequent transactions without affecting your server's TPS (Ticks Per Second). It is the perfect choice for high-population servers (Factions, Skyblock, Prison) where performance is non-negotiable.



🛠️ Intuitive Configuration:

Administrators can easily define which items can be sold and at what price. The clean configuration files allow for rapid setup and adjustments on the fly, giving you total control over your server's market balance.



📊 Real-Time Feedback:

Keep your players informed. The plugin provides clear notifications and messages regarding successful sales, ensuring a transparent and satisfying experience for the user.



❱ WHY CHOOSE AUTOSELL?



Player Retention: Improving quality of life for players leads to longer sessions and a more dedicated community.

Modern Economy: Stay ahead of the competition with a modern approach to Minecraft commerce.

Reliability: Developed under the Revers Studio quality standard, ensuring compatibility and stability.
